create_Sam3TrackerPredictor: create a Sam3TrackerPredictor instance for multi-object video tracking with configurable memory and point prompt settings
init_tracking_state: init an inference state for video tracking with optional video path loading and CPU offloading options
add_new_points_or_box: add click points or bounding box prompts to a frame for object segmentation and tracking
add_new_mask: add a mask prompt to a frame for object segmentation without point inputs
propagate_in_video: propagate tracking across all video frames from a starting frame with optional reverse direction and progress bar
